purpose: Admit sequence-disjoint existing OpenLORIS RGB-D inputs only for descriptive Route A evidence strengthening; not event-detector development or performance evaluation.
required_outputs_per_run: run manifest with source, runner, vocabulary, and camera-config hashes
trajectory presence or explicit failure/UNKNOWN reason

decision_rules.success: All three predeclared runs complete their admission audit; their evidence is descriptive, sequence-disjoint within the OpenLORIS source domain, and may be added to a new data-role manifest without a detector claim.
decision_rules.one_run_failure: Record the failure identity and reason; continue only if the remaining predeclared run is unaffected and no configuration change is made.
decision_rules.same_fault_twice: Stop further runs and audit the runner/protocol before any retry.
decision_rules.input_or_runtime_hash_mismatch: Do not run; mark that candidate INELIGIBLE and do not substitute another sequence based on expected result.
decision_rules.all_runs_complete: Evaluate only after all predeclared identities have been audited; do not select inclusion from candidate coverage or trajectory outcome.

claim_boundary_after_completion: The result can strengthen descriptive sequence-disjoint evidence within one public dataset family. It cannot establish independent cross-dataset generalization, detector performance, causal degradation labels, or a validated threshold.
